hero.subtext: A diversified group operating across construction, petroleum, and trading — delivering infrastructure, energy, and commerce that powers the region.

news.title: Halabja Group Inaugurates New Facility with Senior Officials
news.excerpt: In a landmark ceremony attended by senior government officials and regional leaders, Halabja Group officially opened its latest industrial facility in the Kurdistan Region.

news.title: New Professionals Join the Growing Halabja Group Team
news.excerpt: Halabja Group welcomed a cohort of experienced engineers, managers, and specialists to support its expanding operations across eight sectors.

news.title: Major Project Launch Ceremony in Kurdistan Region
news.excerpt: A high-profile groundbreaking ceremony marked the start of construction on a new infrastructure corridor, backed by Halabja Group subsidiaries.

news.title: Halabja Group Expands Operations Across New Sectors
news.excerpt: The group announced strategic expansions into food industry and renewable energy, reinforcing its position as Kurdistan's most diversified conglomerate.

news.title: Strategic Infrastructure Development Underway in Halabja
news.excerpt: Aran Asphalt and Halabja for General Contracting have jointly commenced work on a critical road network linking key industrial zones in the region.

news.title: Annual Group Summit Brings Leaders Together
news.excerpt: Halabja Group hosted its annual leadership summit, bringing together the CEOs and directors of all 23 subsidiaries to align on strategy for the year ahead.

news.title: Rasan Olive Oil Opens New Cold-Press Plant
news.excerpt: Rasan Olive Oil celebrated the commissioning of its expanded production facility, doubling capacity to meet growing domestic and export demand.

news.title: Halabja Group Celebrates 30 Years of Excellence
news.excerpt: Marking three decades since Halabja Trading's founding in 1992, the group commemorated its journey from a single trading company to a diversified enterprise.

news.title: Ishtar Brick Factory Begins Full Production
news.excerpt: Ishtar Brick Factory reached full operational capacity, supplying millions of premium bricks monthly to construction projects across the Kurdistan Region.
